_comment: Scope strings in ARIA 1.0, by where they are judged (decision D5). issued: what an authority accepts in an agent statement, exactly three lower-case segments namespace:resource:action, each starting with a letter, of letters, digits and underscores, no version, at most 64 characters. credential: what a signed 1.0 document may carry, two or more such segments with no length bound, since credentials issued before D5 may carry them. Receivers’ policy patterns (namespace:resource:*, a matching deny prevails) are ARIA AP’s, in conformance/ap.
